v01-el-celler-de-can-roca.name: El Celler de Can Roca
tags: ★★★; twice World's #1; the Roca brothers' flagship
v01-el-celler-de-can-roca.why: ★★★; twice World's #1; the Roca brothers' flagship. To order: the long "Festival" tasting menu (the only format); the perfume-inspired desserts; the legendary cellar pairing. The defining pilgrimage of Catalan gastronomy — books roughly eleven months ahead the instant the monthly slot opens; reserve before you plan the trip.
v01-el-celler-de-can-roca._lane: The starred line — Girona and the Empordà

v02-bo-tic.name: Bo.TiC
tags: ★★ (second star 2018); chef Albert Sastregener, in a converted carriage factory
v02-bo-tic.why: ★★ (second star 2018); chef Albert Sastregener, in a converted carriage factory. To order: the tasting menu; the seasonal Empordà vegetable courses; pigeon and game in season. Empordanet's quiet two-star, refined regional cooking without the Roca crowds. Coordinate is approximate — sources disagree by ~1.4 km along the C-66; verify the exact building on arrival.
v02-bo-tic._lane: The starred line — Girona and the Empordà

v06-els-tinars.name: Els Tinars
tags: ★; the Gascons family (now Marc Gascons) — elevated Catalan tradition
v06-els-tinars.why: ★; the Gascons family (now Marc Gascons) — elevated Catalan tradition. To order: the arròs/rice dishes; seasonal game; classic Empordà mar-i-muntanya. The benchmark for "elevated traditional" — a country masia, not a lab.
v06-els-tinars.address: Ctra. de Sant Feliu a Girona (C-65) km 7.2, 17240 Llagostera
v06-els-tinars._lane: The starred line — Girona and the Empordà

v04-casamar.name: Casamar
tags: Chef Quim Casellas; held a Michelin star c.2011–2021, no longer starred as of 2026
Dinner at sunset for the bay view
v04-casamar.why: Chef Quim Casellas; held a Michelin star c.2011–2021, no longer starred as of 2026. To order: the tasting menu; local rock-fish and shellfish; Cap-de-Creus-influenced plates. Star or not, the most ambitious cooking in the Palafrugell coves; its door opens onto the camí de ronda steps.
v04-casamar.hours: Dinner at sunset for the bay view
v04-casamar._lane: The cove, the village and the cape

v07-can-bonay.name: Can Bonay
tags: Family restaurant since 1936, in an ancestral stone manor with a small wine cellar/museum
v07-can-bonay.why: Family restaurant since 1936, in an ancestral stone manor with a small wine cellar/museum. To order: the slow-cooked guisats; canelons; classic Empordà mar-i-muntanya. The archetypal old-village Catalan table — stone walls, linen, slow food. Coordinate is village-centre precision (the medieval core is only ~100 m wide).
v07-can-bonay._lane: The cove, the village and the cape

v03-compartir-cadaqu-s.name: Compartir Cadaqués
tags: From Castro, Xatruch & Casañas — the elBulli trio behind three-star Disfrutar
v03-compartir-cadaqu-s.why: From Castro, Xatruch & Casañas — the elBulli trio behind three-star Disfrutar. To order: the "to share" small plates — gambas, the spherified snacks, seasonal fish; the playful desserts. Disfrutar-level creativity at a fraction of the price, in a whitewashed courtyard in Dalí's village.
v03-compartir-cadaqu-s.address: Riera de Sant Vicenç s/n, 17488 Cadaqués
v03-compartir-cadaqu-s._lane: The cove, the village and the cape
